creator: Claude
name: Unmade Single Bed
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 0.05 m chosen to meet the brief's explicit 'avoid toy-like thickness'. At 0.10 m the thinnest possible duvet is 10 cm, the pillow is a single 10 cm slab, and the headboard slats and rails double in thickness; the cloth-versus-wood test fails. At 0.05 m the duvet is a believable 5 cm layer with a rolled fold, turned-over flap, hem and side drape. The mattress is a closed hollow shell to avoid invisible fill.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the frame footprint (1.05 x 2.00 m); the duvet drape adds 0.05 m on the -X side.
front_note: +Y is the FOOT of the bed (accessible end); the headboard is at -Y. The long duvet drape faces -X, toward the default three-quarter camera.
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude pilot palette (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Box 1.05 x 2.00 x 0.50 m plus a thin box for the headboard.
story: Slept in and left in a hurry: the duvet thrown back toward the foot and sliding off the near side, pillow lopsided with the hollow of a head, a paperback left face-down on the sheet.
notes: Sleeping surface (mattress top) at 0.45 m; headboard posts 0.75 m.
Single mattress 0.95 x 1.85 m; hidden slats are modelled for construction logic.

verification.magicavoxel_gui_open: unverified (MagicaVoxel not available in the build environment)
